title: manifest where / migrate (installed layout v2)
summary: Shows which drag-lint.json this engine reads and why; moves the exe-side one to %APPDATA% once (renamed, never deleted). Installed layout v2, off by default
intro: Read this when you need to know which manifest an engine would read. manifest where is read-only. The new layout is off unless DRAGLINT_LAYOUT=v2; an explicit manifest (DRAGLINT_MANIFEST or --manifest) wins in both layouts, and a missing explicit file never falls through to another manifest.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint manifest where [--manifest <path>] [--json] (read-only: which drag-lint.json, log folder and library folder this engine resolves, and each lookup rung. Order: explicit DRAGLINT_MANIFEST / --manifest, then with DRAGLINT_LAYOUT=v2 the file in %APPDATA%\drag-lint, then beside the exe. Creates, moves and renames nothing)
help: drag-lint manifest where [--manifest <path>] [--json]   (read-only: which drag-lint.json, log folder and library folder this engine resolves, and each lookup rung. Order: explicit DRAGLINT_MANIFEST / --manifest, then with DRAGLINT_LAYOUT=v2 the file in %APPDATA%\drag-lint, then beside the exe. Creates, moves and renames nothing)

surfaces.usage: drag-lint manifest migrate [--apply] [--dry-run] [--json] (one-time, installed layout v2 phase 2: without --apply (or with --dry-run, which overrides --apply) plans and touches nothing; with --apply and DRAGLINT_LAYOUT=v2 writes %APPDATA%\drag-lint\drag-lint.json with outDir and relative includes made absolute, so every DB stays put, then RENAMES the exe-side file to drag-lint.json.migrated-<date>. Never deletes, never overwrites. Exit 0 done / would / nothing to do, 2 refused, 1 failed)
